source.dataset: CROWD: City Road Observations With Dashcams (crowd-dataset/crowd)
source.speeds_version: crowd-city crowd_crossing_speed_by_city.csv of 2026-10-08 (99 cities; as copied to bazilinskyy/vlm-crossing crowd/ on 2026-11-03)
source.jaywalking_version: crowd-jaywalking results (prompt zebra-light-v5) as backed up on 2026-10-26: runs crowd_jaywalking_nl, _bgd, _rus_jpn, crowd_capitals, six_countries, korea_vietnam, six_countries_100h (partial)
source.licence: CC BY 4.0 (CROWD DATA_LICENSE.md); YouTube videos are not redistributed
source.citation: Alam, M. S., Bazilinska, O., & Bazilinskyy, P. (2026). A global dataset of continuous urban dashcam driving. arXiv:2604.01044
source.notes: persons/cars per minute: unique YOLO (yolo11x) tracks with confidence >= 0.7 per processed minute of footage, as CROWD's README tables; speed: crowd-city's Waymo-calibrated median crossing speed per city (m/s, q25-q75), country = track-weighted median over its cities; crossing_share: crossing tracks / person tracks of crowd-city; jaywalk_share: crowd-jaywalking's crossings without a visible marked crosswalk or pedestrian light / crossings with a VLM verdict.
